preprocess_image_for_rt_detr: preprocess images and COCO annotations for RT-DETR model input with resize, normalize, and pad operations
post_process_object_detection_outputs: post-process RT-DETR model outputs into final bounding boxes with scores and labels above a threshold
prepare_coco_detection_annotation: prepare COCO detection annotations into RT-DETR target format with boxes, classes, area, and keypoints
resize_image_with_aspect_ratio: resize a torch tensor image to a target size while optionally preserving aspect ratio
resize_annotation_bounding_boxes: resize annotation bounding boxes, masks, and area to match a new image size
